integrity: Critical polynomial identities and the jerk equality-case reduction were replayed from the packaged checker. Literature comparisons are limited to material actually inspected.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and periodic orbits, not unbounded trajectories.
For positive parameter it gives necessary structural laws, not existence of nontrivial recurrence for every parameter pair.
The complete 2004 analytical Sprott-flow paper was not inspected and remains a bibliographic risk.
Targeted searches cannot exclude differently phrased or unindexed older results.
title: Compact-recurrence trichotomy and strict period floor in the generalized Sprott J flow
